name: 10-K8
description: 10-K8, also known as K8, and Ten-Kayt, was a droid with feminine programming that belonged to the bodyguard Alys "Crash" Ongwa, who led a security team during the High Republic Era. The droid was present with Ongwa when she was hired to protect Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh after the attack on Valo.
